title: Resolvent, spectrum and resonances for the acoustic operator with piecewise constant coefficients
summary: We study the acoustic operator $A_{v,ρ}:=v^{2}ρ\nabla\!\cdotρ^{-1}\nabla$ with transmission conditions at the boundary of $Ω=Ω_{1}\cup\dots\cupΩ_{n}$, where the $Ω_{\ell}$'s are connected disjoint open bounded Lipschitz domains, the positive functions $v$ and $ρ$ are constant on each connected component of $Ω$ and $v=ρ=1$ on ${\mathbb R}^{3}\backslash\overlineΩ$.
